subject: PO requirements, invoice cadence, and pricing slab for Calyx commitment
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@calyxhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@calyxhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: PO template + invoice cadence question for Redwood commitment

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the conversations last week — Calyx procurement is ready to move forward but we need to validate a couple of operational pieces before issuing a formal PO. Quick questions:

1) PO fields: our ERP needs vendor tax ID, vendor remit address, billing entity name (legal), and a cost_center string for ledger mapping. Can Redwood accept a PO that includes those fields? We can attach the standard Calyx PO template to make this explicit (attached).

2) Invoice cadence: Calyx ops requires consolidated monthly invoicing (one invoice per month across all Redwood SKUs) tied to the PO. Is that supported? If we must do multiple invoices / weekly, we need to map to a single consolidated invoice file in our ERP.

3) Net terms: our baseline is Net45. Procurement will push to Net60 only for capital projects. Is Net45 acceptable? If Net45 is not within Redwood policy for the pricing slab we've discussed, please tell us the delta.

4) Pricing slab confirmation: procurement needs a short written confirmation of the discount that will apply given Net45 + monthly invoices vs prepaid annual commitment. We discussed a volume-based slab on the call but need the exact numbers to include in our PO.

Attached: Calyx_PO_Template.pdf (fillable). If you can get back with a short note addressing the three items and a pricing confirmation we can circulate to finance and issue a PO.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re aiming to have a PO in the next 7 business days.

Best,
Alex Turner
Senior Procurement Manager
Calyx Health

---
Attachment: Calyx_PO_Template.pdf (fillable PDF; fields: PO number, billing_entity, vendor_tax_id, remit_address, cost_center, start_date, end_date, invoice_email)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@calyxhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-11T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoice cadence question for Redwood commitment

Alex — thanks, and great to move quickly on this. Answers inline below.

1) PO fields: Yes — Redwood can accept a PO containing vendor_tax_id, remit_address, billing_entity, and cost_center. Please make sure billing_entity matches the legal name exactly (Redwood Inference, Inc.) for tax/1099 mapping. We also need a billing_email field (where invoices should be sent) and an explicit PO start/end date or term.

2) Invoice cadence: We can support consolidated monthly invoicing (one invoice per month) and will map usage across SKUs into a single invoice file. That works fine for our finance team.

3) Net terms: Net45 is acceptable from a contract perspective, but it affects the pricing slab. Our baseline public pricing assumed Net30 monthly billing. For Net45 consolidated monthly invoices we apply a pricing adjustment.

4) Pricing slab (high level):
- Option A (preferred): Annual prepay or committed annual spend >= $250k — 12% discount off list; consolidated monthly statements still provided for consumption visibility, invoices zeroed (prepaid credit).
- Option B: Monthly billing, Net30 — 8% discount on committed ARR.
- Option C: Monthly billing, Net45 (what you requested) — 5% discount on committed ARR.

We can make a one-time concession for this deal: if Calyx signs a 12-month commitment and includes a PO referencing the commitment (PO must include start/end and committed spend band) we can move Option C to 7% instead of 5% (i.e., sweeten by 2 points) — on the condition the PO is issued within 10 business days and legal/finance sign the SOW as-is.

Next steps I'd propose: you send the filled PO (with fields populated) and we’ll validate it on our side; Vanessa (cc) will confirm invoicing mechanics with finance; Priyom (cc) will do a quick review of the PO wording and return any redlines. If you accept the 7% concession path we’ll prepare a short confirmation email for procurement to attach to the PO.

Sending the Redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx (attached) which spells each slab and the calculation example.

Thanks — I’ll leave Vanessa and Priyom to operationalize after we receive the template.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet: slabs, thresholds, examples)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@calyxhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@calyxhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-12T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoice cadence question for Redwood commitment

On Fri, Dec 11, 2026 at 11:02 AM rishi_malhotra@redwood.com wrote:
> Alex — thanks, and great to move quickly on this. Answers inline below.
> 
> 1) PO fields: Yes — Redwood can accept a PO containing vendor_tax_id, remit_address, billing_entity, and cost_center. Please make sure billing_entity matches the legal name exactly (Redwood Inference, Inc.) for tax/1099 mapping. We also need a billing_email field (where invoices should be sent) and an explicit PO start/end date or term.

Thanks Rishi — that helps. A couple of clarifications from Calyx ops:

• We cannot do Net30 at scale (finance mandate). Net45 is our default.
• Our ERP requires the PO number to be generated with a Calyx prefix (format CLYX-YYYY-####). Can Redwood accept that PO numbering convention?
• We will provide a filled PO (see attached filled_calyx_po_7643.pdf) with vendor_tax_id and remit addresses included. The PO references a committed spend band but not a prepay.

On pricing: procurement says the 7% concession is acceptable if Redwood will:
- honor consolidated monthly invoices and
- include a 60-day grace period clause for invoice disputes (no invoice adjustments longer than 60 days), and
- provide a single line item in the invoice describing the committed discount (so our ERP picks it up).

Can Redwood confirm acceptance on those three operational requests? If yes, we will route the PO to finance and aim to issue it tomorrow.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior Procurement Manager
Calyx Health

---
Attachment: filled_calyx_po_7643.pdf (filled PO; fields: PO number CLYX-2026-7643, billing_entity=Calyx Health, vendor_tax_id=12-3456789, remit_address included, cost_center=CLY-HS-03)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@calyxhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-14T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoice cadence question for Redwood commitment

Alex — great, thanks for the filled PO and the clear asks. Confirmations below: 

• PO numbering: yes, Redwood Finance accepts external PO numbers in the Calyx format (e.g., CLYX-2026-7643) — we will record it in our ledger as-is.

• Consolidated monthly invoices: confirmed. We will produce one consolidated invoice per month and include a single line describing the committed discount and the discount calculation reference (SKU-level detail remains in the invoice attachment).

• 60-day dispute window: we can accept your 60-day dispute clause (Redwood standard is 90 days but we will make this concession for this deal).

• Pricing: given Net45 + consolidated monthly invoicing we will honor the 7% concession (one-time uplift from 5% to 7%) provided the PO includes the committed spend band and is issued within 10 business days, and both sides sign the SOW with no material redlines.

Next steps:
1) Rishi to generate a short confirmation email template that you can attach to the PO stating the 7% concession and invoice mechanics.
2) Vanessa will send an email to Redwood finance to expect CLYX-2026-7643 and confirm remit details.
3) Priyom will review the PO wording for any legal flags — minor comments only expected.
4) I will send a DocuSign link to the SOW once we receive the PO; then we’ll be ready to onboard.

I’ve attached Redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx which has the final slab math for record. Please confirm when the PO is issued and we’ll push the SOW.

Thanks — excited to get Calyx live.

— Rishi
